item.title: Slides as a Single HTML File
item.author: info@roaldnefs.com (Roald Nefs)
item.description: I want to spend my time on what a talk says, not on building PowerPoints. deckfile puts the slides, the engine and the theme in one HTML file that opens straight from disk, with a presenter view, an edit view in the browser and a skill that lets a coding agent write the deck.

item.title: Your Coding Agent Runs as You
item.author: info@roaldnefs.com (Roald Nefs)
item.description: A coding agent on your laptop runs as your user, with every key you have. This is the written version of my aiGrunn talk on why that needs a sandbox, what a sandbox has to limit, and five places to run an agent instead.
